sentences.text: 5 03-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 341, 323, 498A,379,307/34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections  of the DP Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that both parties have resolved and settled their dispute in terms of settlement dated 14.11.2024 mutually agreed upon by them.
A copy of the settlement is annexed with the mediator's report dated 20.11.2024.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19597 of 2024(5) dt.03-01-2025 5.
Considering the mediator's report, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Araria in Forbesganj (Simraha) Police Station Rahbar vs The State Of Bihar on 3 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181940686/
1 Case No. 559 of 2023, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure as well as in terms of settlement.
